name: prod-mongo
description: Verified backups of Conventioner's production database into ~/conventioner-backups, restore drills that prove they restore into a throwaway local MongoDB, rehearsals of a release's migrations on a dump with no route out, and undos prepared for Daniel to run, on the read user's connection string from 1Password at server start, which reaches mongodump only through a FIFO. Loaded only into the ops role.
